AWS Bedrock returns 403 Forbidden (not 401) when credentials are missing, expired, or the IAM role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest
from liter_llm import AuthenticationError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0"}')
        await client.chat(req)
    except AuthenticationError as error:
        print(f"AuthenticationError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
